entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Flooding from the Conway River is impacting the highway near Hawkswood and the Kowhai River has breached its banks, triggering a state of emergency for the Kaikōura district | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

NZTA says State Highway 1 will remain closed overnight as the extensive flooding is expected to continue.

⚠️ RNZ is New Zealand's statutory civil defence lifeline radio broadcaster, providing vital information and updates as they come to hand. All frequencies can be found at rnz.co.nz/listen
